verdict.rationale: Codegen's agent-permissions settings document a toggle that lets the agent automatically detect and apply rules from rule files in your repositories. That is the product's own mechanism for repo-level convention context. It is only a single settings line, with no detail on supported file names or formats, how the rules shape plans versus code, or how precedence works. Missing for 10: supported rule-file formats and locations, documentation of how rules influence plan and code generation, hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can add a context file describing my codebase conventions so agents generate more relevant plans and code

citations.quote: Allow the agent to automatically detect and apply rules from various rule files in your repositories.
